svg.title: Real-space Kohn–Sham DFT: Figures 6, 8 and 9
svg.desc: Original figures from Zhang et al., Chemical Communications (2025), DOI 10.1039/D5CC01820J. Figure 6: carbonate at the air–water interface. Figure 8: wood-derived carbon capture. Figure 9: carbon dioxide on graphene. The three original figures are arranged without content changes.
